newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian policeman dies from wounds in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian policeman dies from wounds in clashes.

text.p: A Palestinian policeman died on Monday from wounds he sustained during gun battles with Israeli soldiers last month, the Palestinian health ministry said.

His death raised to 59 the number of Palestinians killed in clashes that erupted in September after Israel opened a new entrance to an archaeological tunnel near a Moslem shrine in Jerusalem. Fifteen Israeli soldiers have been killed in the violence.
Ministry officials named the policeman as Raed Ilayan al-Riqib, 25, from Gaza. They said he was shot in the head.
